profile_code_with_context_manager: use the Profiler class as a context manager to profile a block of code with cProfile
start_stop_profiler_manually: manually start and stop the Profiler using Start and End methods to profile code
check_profiler_stats_periodically: call Check on the Profiler to automatically print top N cumulative stats at intervals
review_profiler_is_enabled: review whether the Profiler instance is currently enabled using the IsEnabled method
summarize_profiler_class: summarize the Profiler class which wraps cProfile with context manager, manual, and periodic printing modes
